items.title: French startup Bleu Robotics secures €5 million to teach humanoid robots new tasks with fewer demonstrations
items.summary: Bleu Robotics, a Paris-based startup building AI models for industrial humanoid robots, has raised a €5 million pre-Seed round, to reach its goal of reducing the full humanoid robot deployment process to one hour or shorter.
